display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 共用 R17 物理回投影实增益筛查
description: 使用同一共享核心、相同源域目标和推理公式，分别在 LoRa 与 WiSig 合法源 U 训练，并对单 RX 的低城区与 clean 做预登记同包筛查。
authorization: 用户要求两个数据集使用通用融合方法，优先 R02/R07/R17；显存充足立即启动并保护其他 owner。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CUDA FP32 / TF32 off, CPU independent scorer

data.contract_ref: lora_rx5_main_v1:392005; ManySig Main original 7/63/30 F0 seed392005; VALIDATED_ONCE source caches
data.representation: one common gain architecture, LoRa [8,1024] and WiSig [8,32], same normalization and loss
data.physical_ids_ref: existing first cross-data screen physical IDs, same paired channel observations
data.exposure: both fixed source panels and historical benchmark previously exposed; no target read or model selection from target

permissions.claim_scope: Separate same-dataset source U training of same method; no F or TX label in training. Frozen dataset recognizers and original heads only in source prediction; source V truth opened only after complete paired predictions.

checkpoint.initialization: SharedDuraRealGain zero initialized independently, no cross-dataset weights; each frozen R17 same-contract original source-trained checkpoint

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions

checkpoint.selection_rule: Source train fixed final step 2000. LoRa each preregistered difficult half net >=1 and clean >=-1 against each control; WiSig each half net >=2 and clean >=-2 against each control, including DURA v1. LoRa fixed DURA v1 matching control is pending; prohibit promotion until available.

execution.gpu_policy: User latest says start when sufficient VRAM. Two distinct GPUs, each >=8192 MiB free at launch and at most one worker from this run per card; preserve all other owner processes. Actual total GPU occupancy recorded by preflight.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

rows.method: same SharedDuraRealGain: frozen R02/R07/R17, physical backprojection and two real spectral gains

data_overrides.training: U_s only; no TX or classifier

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates, batch 4, U_s only, no F or TX

rows.method: same SharedDuraRealGain: frozen R02/R07/R17, physical backprojection and two real spectral gains

data_overrides.training: U_s only; no TX or classifier

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates, batch 24, U_s only, no F or TX

notes: Exact same SharedDuraRealGain class, one mathematical inference rule, optimizer and loss for both; packet grouping and source checkpoints are dataset-specific, weights separately trained.
L = waveform MSE + 0.3 spectral error + 1.5 clean retention vs respective frozen R17 output. Identical per-packet normalization in train and inference.
Existing source V predictions/results were previously exposed. No target signals, truth or target statistics are used. Independent truth-last scoring after each row's full fixed screen.
No full test without all preregistered comparisons and promotion.
